RootMC admin — #work-log Quick one-line notes as you work. Discord stays the public server; this is *staff scratchpad only*.

*Format:* `[area] what happened — next step`

Examples:
• `[Towny] lotto broadcast fix built 1.0.4 — pending FileZilla`
• `[Web] /pro page ready — needs Pages deploy`
• `[API] nothing today`
*Areas:* `Towny`, `Claims`, `Web`, `API`, `Android`, `Plugin:<name>`, `Ops`

Cursor can digest this channel weekly for a full update. No automations wired here yet. *Sent using* Cursor

*Current function (2026-07-30)*

`#work-log` = your daily scratchpad. Post _new messages_ here (not threads) whenever you touch something cross-cutting.

*What belongs here:* deploys, blockers, "waiting on X", quick wins across Towny/Claims/Web/API.
*What doesn't:* plugin-specific detail → use `#plugins` thread; machine logs → future `#ops-feed`; final policy calls → `#decisions`.

*Live stack today:*
• *Towny host* — main economy, Towny, most heartbeat plugins
• *Claims host* — personal claims + Root-Road
• *Web* — <http://rootmc.net|rootmc.net> (Pages), `/pro`, wiki, plugin manifest
• *API* — <http://api.rootmc.net|api.rootmc.net> (Worker: Discord, economy, realm, developer OAuth)
• *Slack* — admin notes only; Discord still owns community + automations
Cursor can digest this channel for weekly summaries. *Sent using* Cursor
